capabilities: Browse and filter recipe notes in a card grid
Generate categorised shopping lists from marked recipes
Scale recipe quantities with a serving multiplier
Write combined cooking session notes with prep list and cook order
Check and fix prep technique tags on ingredient lines
extras: Writes only the shopping list and cook session flags in recipe frontmatter, session notes and an optional saved shopping list note; it makes no network requests of its own, though cover images given as web addresses load from the web.
problem: Recipe notes scattered across a vault are hard to filter by ingredient or diet, and turning them into a shopping list or a batch-cook plan takes manual work.
summary: Recipe manager that browses and filters recipe notes, builds aisle-sorted shopping lists, and writes combined cooking session notes.
